## Status

**No PHI may be shared with Tallgrass until the BAA is executed.** Under the HIPAA privacy policy, a vendor that will create, receive, maintain or transmit PHI on our behalf is a business associate, and we must have a signed BAA before any PHI is disclosed — including test files or "just a few names" for a pilot.

Until then, the post-visit satisfaction score for Juniper and in-person visits is collected with the in-app survey in the Halcyon app.

## Next steps

- Privacy Officer (Margaret Holloway) to send revised retention language by November 6, 2026.
- If the BAA is not signed by January 31, 2027, QPS will look at other survey vendors.
